TEXT:
[FI] And so, the long-awaited trip with Ayase starts 
today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Ah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Hm?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...You're going out?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Oh, right. You've got a date with Ayase today, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] How did you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Ayase told me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're heading out as well?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Yeah. I promised Kanako to hang out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] O-Oh.

[FI] I appeared to be calm, but I must admit I was a 
little surprised by her.

[FI] I mean, Kirino answering honestly to one of my 
questions? Hope it doesn't rain today...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, you! You just thought of something rude, 
didn't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're just accusing me of nothing!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] That so? Well, I'm off then!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Seriously, what's up with her attitude?

[FI] Well, nothing I can do about that. Psyching myself 
up, I headed out for the station where Ayase 
would be waiting.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, Onii-san!

[FI] Having seen me, Ayase showed a wide smile as she 
started waving at me.

[FI] ...The sudden attention from everyone else kinda 
hurt, in a way, but I've stopped caring. Yep.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sorry, did you wait long?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] No, I just got here myself.

[FI] Oh man, Ayase-tan is so cute today, as always! Feels 
like ten more years were added to my lifespan just 
from seeing her smile.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Man, the weather's great today.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Yes, it really is...

[FI] And with that, our conversation was cut short... Huh? 
That's odd. Usually, we'd have more to talk about...

SPEAKER: SPK_BOTH
TEXT: [FI] You know--

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...You first, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Um, which train are we taking?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] The one headed for Atami in about ten minutes... Oh, 
and I've bought the tickets already, so don't worry 
about that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] O-Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So, what did you want to say, Ayase?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, no, I was just thinking maybe we should get on 
the train soon.

[FI] Saying that, Ayase bashfully looked down. What's 
up with this mood? My pulse is rapidly increasing...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] L-Let's go then.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, yes.

[FI] Dealing with the embarrassment, I took Ayase's 
hand and started walking. Likewise, Ayase held my 
hand steadily.

[FI] We boarded the train and were now on our way to 
Atami.

[FI] We were both so nervous that we just couldn't 
seem to start a conversation. Felt like our hands 
were burning with embarrassment.

[FI] Hmm, what should we talk about during times like 
these?

[FI] Glancing at Ayase, her face was completely red, 
and I could feel my face growing hotter by the 
minute.

[FI] Ah, but you know, Ayase's totally an angel. She's so 
cute.

[FI] I was planning to steal a glance every now and then 
when she wasn't looking, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] If you keep glancing at me like that, people will 
think you're... weird.

[FI] ...Without anything else to do, I was looking out the 
window, and before I knew it, the train had arrived 
at Atami.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Whoa...!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Wow!

[FI] As we got off the train, both Ayase and I breathed 
a sigh of admiration at the scene before us.

[FI] A brilliant blue sky was now stretching out where 
there had been clouds this morning. We got 
wrapped up in the liveliness of the sight-seeing area.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] There's a lot of people here today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, it's been rather hot lately.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, what could that be?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hm? Probably a souvenir shop?

[FI] The change in environment helped a lot. As if the 
recent embarrassment hadn't existed, a 
conversation now sprung naturally.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] For starters, let's go to the beach!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] S-Sure.

[FI] Ayase, who had completely reverted to her usual 
self, grabbed my arm and we started walking 
down the streets of Atami.
